title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
author: arxiv.org
summary: RoboTTT is a new robot model that learns from very long visuomotor sequences, up to 8,000 steps, much longer than previous methods. It updates its internal parameters during both training and use, allowing it to remember and use context better. This leads to improved robot actions, such as one-shot imitation and better performance on long tasks.
